story.iWant: to apply a frosted glass effect to my link buttons
story.soThat: my page has a modern, premium depth
story.tasks: - Add glass_effect, glass_blur, glass_opacity columns - Update shared schema with new fields - Create glassmorphism CSS styles with backdrop-filter - Apply glass effect to ArtistPage buttons - Add Glass Effect UI controls to DesignTab - Update EditorPreview - Test browser compatibility and fallbacks

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Glass Effect toggle in Button Effects section AC2: When enabled, link buttons have frosted glass appearance AC3: Background shows through with blur, creating depth AC4: Blur intensity options: Light (4px), Medium (8px), Heavy (16px) AC5: Opacity adjustable (10%-50%) AC6: Effect works best with gradient/image backgrounds AC7: Fallback styling for browsers without backdrop-filter AC8: Preview updates in real-time

dependencies.dep: No story dependencies - can start independently

constraints.constraint: Use backdrop-filter: blur() with -webkit prefix for Safari
Must provide fallback for browsers without backdrop-filter support
Glass effect overrides default button background when enabled
Include subtle border for glass edge definition

tests.ideas: - Test all 3 blur intensity levels - Test opacity range - Test in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge - Verify fallback in unsupported browsers - Test performance on mobile - Test with different background types
